title: The Missing Half of the Recipe (レシピの消えた半分)

scenes.title: 四号室の二度鳴るベル
scenes.summary: Room 4's desk buzzer gives its signature double ring, and Evelyn brings the old green cloth botanical book downstairs to inspect with Hannah and Graham.

scenes.title: ミントの葉のあいだ
scenes.summary: In Room 9, Evelyn lifts the missing bottom half of the berry-and-almond cake recipe from between pressed mint leaves, though an old raindrop blurred the final line.

scenes.title: 三つの小さな焼き型
scenes.summary: In the cafe kitchen, Tessa puts aprons on Owen and Hannah to bake three small test cakes with three different glazes.

scenes.title: 一回目は酸っぱすぎて
scenes.summary: After Arthur measures the lemon glaze for Batch One without his reading glasses, Graham takes one bite and declares it sour enough to polish brass.

scenes.title: 二回目はカリッと響く
scenes.summary: Owen grills brown sugar over Batch Two, making a stone-hard shell that clangs under Caleb's fork while hiding warm almond cake underneath.

scenes.title: 押し葉のページの香り
scenes.summary: Evelyn and Tessa tilt the ink-smudged card in the sunroom light and sniff the pressed botanical book, discovering the glaze is warm honey and grated orange peel.

scenes.title: 鉛筆で十点満点
scenes.summary: Graham tastes Batch Three, approves it with a capital-letter 10/10 in his notebook, and sneaks a second slice.

scenes.title: 二階の赤い星
scenes.summary: Outside by Table One, Caleb, Hannah, and Graham spot forged iron rings on the upstairs balcony and courtyard tree, revealing where anniversary lanterns hung, and plan to test knots before Friday's wind.
